Balmain Bike Bus

Sydney, Australia · Balmain · Social

Balmain Bike Bus is a social group ride in Sydney, Australia. It rolls every Wednesday at 8:00 am local time from Loyalty Square, outside Woolworths, Balmain.

RSVP on the Bike Leichhardt Meetup page. After Pyrmont people go on to work, have a coffee, or ride home.

a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.

Check

About the Balmain Bike Bus group ride

A led commute ride from Balmain through White Bay Power Station and over the Anzac Bridge to Union Square on Harris Street, Pyrmont. Run by the Climate Change Balmain-Rozelle group and posted on the Bike Leichhardt Meetup.
